title: Andhra Pradesh to Procure 1,600 MW Thermal Power

blocks.content: Andhra Pradesh Electricity Regulatory Commission (APERC) granted in-principle approval on 6 August 2026 for the state distribution companies to begin competitive bidding for 1,600 MW of coal-based thermal power. The procurement will use the tariff-based Design, Build, Finance, Own and Operate (DBFOO) model under Section 63 of the Electricity Act, 2003.

items: Section 63 of the Electricity Act, 2003 provides for tariff determination through competitive bidding.
DBFOO stands for Design, Build, Finance, Own and Operate.
APERC is the State Electricity Regulatory Commission for Andhra Pradesh.
Coal-based thermal power is a dispatchable source of electricity and is used for meeting peak demand.
